title: Social Security Just Got a 3.6% Raise for 2027
description: Social Security benefits rise 3.6% for 2027 (up from 2.8% in 2026), starting with January 2027 payments. The SSA says the average retired worker goes from about $2,095 to $2,170 a month, roughly $75 more. Educational only, not financial advice. #socialsecurity #retirement #shorts

title: He Just Wanted to Sell Snowboards. Then Came Shopify
description: In 2004 in Ottawa, Tobi Lütke found e-commerce software clunky, so he built his own for his online snowboard shop, Snowdevil. That software became Shopify, and merchants sold $378.4 billion through it in 2025. #shopify #entrepreneur #shorts
